grid.description: Uniform spatial grid. Field arrays Ec (required) and Bc (optional) have shape (Nf, 3, Nz, Ny, Nx) where axis 1 is vector component (x, y, z). Legacy 4D (Nf, Nz, Ny, Nx) scalar Ez is auto-promoted by the loader.

freqs.description: Angular frequencies omega_k (rad/s), one per Nf slice, strictly increasing. Nf=1: monochromatic + temporal envelope from 'pulse'. Nf>1: pulse already synthesized from the frequency stack.

power_W.description: Power delivered to the focus (after apodizer/truncation losses).

pol.description: z-linear = bidipole linear polarization; circular: a_max^CP = a_max/sqrt(2), cut alpha > 0.7 a_max^CP/gamma.

pulse.description: Envelope g(t); intensity FWHM convention (sigma_t is the FIELD-envelope sigma = tau_fwhm/sqrt(4 ln 2) ~ tau_fwhm/1.665).

checks.description: Self-validation metadata; loader verifies a_max and power_conservation_rel_err against the loaded arrays and raises ValueError on mismatch.

a_max.description: Peak electric field amplitude in a0 = e|E|/(mc*omega0), from the stack.

a_max_expected.description: Theory reference: ~551.5*sqrt(P/1PW) for LP bidipole (wavelength-independent; scaled by truncated aperture and 1/sqrt(2) for CP).

chi_max_per_GeV.description: Peak chi per GeV of electron energy; compare with Fig. 4.
